name: cua-hard/q4-renewal-closeout
description: Close out an account manager's Q4 FY27 renewals across Salesforce, DocuSign, Yahoo Mail and Google Calendar: book Closed Won only for fully executed envelopes at the annual fee of the executed quote version (local CPQ export), close a written non-renewal as Closed Lost and void its envelope, file executed envelopes, book 45-minute kickoffs at the agreed UK time without clashes (adding the VP for large renewals), and write a close-out CSV.
